{{Quote|I'm afraid the Prime Minister remains busy. However, a new matter has arisen that demands authoritative action. Terrorists from the fringe Talus and Tralus Liberation Party have stolen valuable state secrets. I urge you to retrieve these secrets and resolve this situation regarding these insurgents. Will you help up?|Haleen Snowline|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Haleen Snowline''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as the [[Minister of Protocol]] for [[Hagrin Zeed]], the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. She lived and worked in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]].

==Biography==
Snowline was involved in Zeed's criminal activities. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver a bribe from Zeed to the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]] who had acquired evidence of Zeed's wrongdoings. When the Liberation Party let Snowline know that they still had the evidence and that the Prime Minister could expect to hear from them again, Snowline had the spacer attack the Liberation Party members. She described them as [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] that had stolen valuable state secrets. The spacer retrieved the evidence, leaving no survivors. Now that the spacer had proven to be a valuable asset, he was allowed to meet the prime minister.

==Behind the scenes==
Haleen Snowline was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. She could be found in the capitol building in Dearic where she offered two simple quests to players.
